recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait where half the subject's face is completely obscured by deep shadow, merging into a solid black background, while the other half is brightly illuminated to reveal texture and form.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject face bisected by light and shadow
Brightest highlights on hair and forehead against pure black negative space
Typography anchored in the upper right quadrant for balance
Direct eye contact from the visible eye creating a focal point
coreInvariants: Hard-edged shadow line on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically, slightly offset to the left; large scale filling the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The visible left eye of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright highlights of the hair, down to the visible eye, then across to the typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant on the right side and bottom, creating a sense of mystery and isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black (#000000) for background and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle blue-gray tint across the midtones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-range grays in the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif for the primary line; wide sans-serif for the secondary line.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, blocky serifs with low contrast strokes
Secondary text uses geometric, all-caps sans-serif with wide tracking

composition.relationshipToImage: Aligned with display text right edge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, traditional slab serif and a modern, airy geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Wide tracking on the second line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and 70s aesthetic.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, black and white portrait of a person with longish hair. Use split lighting (chiaroscuro) so one side of the face is in total darkness, merging into a black background. Apply a subtle cool blue tint to the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the upper right corner, right-aligned. The top line should be a bold slab serif in title case. The bottom line should be a geometric sans-serif in all caps with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the right side of the face completely lost to shadow?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper corner?
Is the color palette strictly monochrome with a cool tint?

adjustableVariables: Amount of hair detail visible in the highlights
Tracking width of the subtitle text
mustRedesign: Any visible logos in the bottom corners
Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for true black (#000000) in at least 40% of the frame.
Ensure the visible eye is sharp and in focus.
Verify the slab serif and sans-serif pairing maintains a clear hierarchy.
Confirm the blue tint is subtle and not a primary color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + [Subject Type] + [Cool/Warm Tint] + Right-Aligned Dual-Font Typography
